title: Continuous compactly supported cut-off of the pulled-back form ω(f)∘Df that agrees with it on K
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let O ⊆ ℝ^P be open and K ⊆ O compact. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be of class C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O). Let ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) be a continuous n-form (a continuous map into the n-covectors Covector (Euclid P) n). Then there is a continuous, compactly supported h : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) such that h(x) = ω(f(x))∘Df(x) for every x ∈ K. Here ω(f(x))∘Df(x) := (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n), Continuous ω → IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → ∃ h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous h ∧ HasCompactSupport h ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, h x = (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)
